text:
maria: Quick design pass — proposing an 'aurora-slate' dark theme for Console. Sketch uploaded: https://redwood.design/aurora-slate (screenshot). Focus areas: chart palettes, syntax token colors, and axis legibility at small sizes.

sam: Love the baseline. Two quick a11y asks: make sure body copy hits 4.5:1 against bg and axis labels 3:1 at 12px. Charts need a distinct colorblind-safe palette for up to 8 series. :white_check_mark:

ash: Agree. For syntax highlighting I'd lean cooler for keywords (#6CC0FF), warm amber for strings (#FFB86B), muted mauve for types (#BFA5D8). But we should run contrast checks against the proposed bg.

kevin: Charts — avoid pure red/green pairs. Suggest palette: teal, amber, indigo, coral, olive, slate. Use semi-transparent strokes for overlapping series. Example CSS tokens for the theme:
```
--aurora-bg: #07131A;
--aurora-surface: #0B1C22;
--aurora-accent-1: #20C7B2; /* teal */
--aurora-accent-2: #FFB86B; /* amber */
```

design-bot: Contrast scan results: body (14px) on #07131A -> #D7E7EE = 5.2:1 ✅; axis labels (12px) -> #B0C6D1 = 3.0:1 (borderline) — consider bumping axis to #C4D8E0 for headroom.

maria: Nice, can we push axis -> #C4D8E0 and increase tick weight by 1px for small charts? Also need legend swatches to be visually distinct at 16px (high DPI). :thinking_face:

ash: For code block token colors, avoid using #BFA5D8 for types — it falls under 4.5. Swap to #D6C7F3 or make type text semibold. Also reduce saturation for comments to keep them background-muted.

sam: Heatmaps should use a perceptually uniform gradient (viridis-like), not a rainbow. Also ensure single-color gradients preserve meaning when printed B/W (hint patterns or hatching).

kevin: On tooltips, propose backdrop blur + 1px outline so they pop without raising overall luminosity. Tooltip font-size 13px, line-height 18px.

maria: Action items: ash to update token palette, kevin to produce 8-series colorblind-safe chart PNGs, sam to run the full a11y sweep, i'll open UI PR with tokens + design-bot suggested axis tweak. Thanks! :sparkles:

ash: On it — will push palette changes to the branch and add contrast table. ETA tomorrow AM.

design-bot: PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2117 :eyes: (auto: contrast check queued)

kevin: Tiny copy nit — settings label 'Toggle dark theme' reads like an action. Suggest: 'Dark mode: ON' / 'Dark mode: OFF' for clarity.

maria: Good catch. Let's standardize copy across settings and dark-mode toggles. I'll update the copy doc. :thumbsup:
